label: Quality check
description: Before the agent answers, a second AI checks the work against your checklist and sends it back with what is missing, up to a set number of times. Technical: deepagents RubricMiddleware; grading streams as ac.rubric events.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The AI model that checks the work. Plug in an “AI model” block.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Optional. Tools the checker may use to verify the work (run tests, read files).

outputs.name: middleware
outputs.description: Plug this into an agent's “middleware” input.

rubric.title: Rubric
rubric.description: What done looks like, one criterion per line

grader_instructions.title: Grader instructions
grader_instructions.description: Replaces the grader's default system prompt
